You each get two cards face down and one face up, followed by three more face-up streets and a final face-down card, with a round of betting after every street. Your best five of seven wins. Heads-up, the low up card acts first, and that's your 9♠.

Third street: you're holding a pair of nines, with the 9♥ in the hole. I'm showing the Q♦. You can check, bet 20 or fold.
